title: How Judgments Happen
coreMove: identify the hidden scale your mind used when it answered a vague question quickly
sourcePressure: tracks how quick judgments borrow intensity, substitute dimensions, and convert vague questions into simpler impressions
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: summarizing judgment as pure emotion instead of intensity-matching and dimension substitution

hook: opening with a named bias definition for How Judgments Happen
starting in a lecture hall or generic seminar
counterintuition: the obvious advice is simply slow down
smart people are immune if they know the term
tryThisNow: write three lessons in a journal
examples: student in a classroom guessing an answer
